name: Flooding (Example)
summary: EXAMPLE ONLY. A sample workflow for demonstrating work centers and schedules — not a real flood procedure.

checklist.title: Before you start
checklist.intro: Example workflow only. It is here to show branching, parallel tracks and scheduling. It is not a flood procedure and must not be used in a real emergency.
items: Site drainage plan and sump locations
Electrical panel schedule for the lower levels

question.prompt: Where is the water coming from?
question.help: A burst pipe is shut off at the valve. Rising ground water is not — it has to be kept out and waited out.
question.label: Source

steps.title: Find the water
steps.body: Check the cameras and the leak alarms. Note which level it is on and how fast it is rising.

steps.title: Inside — shut the valve
steps.body: Close the isolation valve for that line and open the nearest drain. The leak stops before anything else matters.

steps.title: Outside — keep it out
steps.body: Sandbag the low doorways and vents on the flood side. You cannot stop it, only slow it.

steps.title: Not known — do both
steps.body: Isolate the most likely line and sandbag the low openings. Sort out which it was afterwards.

steps.title: Cut power to the wet area
steps.body: Open the breakers for the affected level before anyone walks into standing water. Confirm it is dead.

steps.title: Close off the area
steps.body: Lock the stairwell and lift to that level so nobody wanders in. Put someone on the door if you can.

steps.title: Call facilities and the utility
steps.body: Report the level, the source if you know it, and whether power has been cut. Ask for an arrival time.

steps.title: Tell the building
steps.body: Announce which level is closed and which stairs to use. People will try the flooded route otherwise.

steps.title: Lift what you can
steps.body: Get records, servers and stock off the floor. Only in areas that are dry and powered down.

steps.title: Start the pumps
steps.body: Run the sumps and portable pumps, discharging away from the building. Check the sump alarms are clear.

steps.title: Account for everyone
steps.body: Radio each floor warden and confirm nobody is on the affected level, including contractors.

steps.title: Log it and monitor
steps.body: Record the level, the time, the source and what was isolated. Keep watching until the water drops.
